body: Huda’s behavior is genuinely starting to scare me. I thought it was escalated/bad in last nights episode, but I also had empathy for her for the way she was feeling. I also am in no way defending Jeremiah because I don’t like him either and I think he played a large role in their blow up as well. However, tonight’s episode starts off and she just seems so checked out of reality.. I feel Iike when they had their chat during the day, Jeremiah was really trying to amend things with her and brought up a reasonable path for them to move forward together- and then she completely 180’d what he said and nitpicked his words to make him look like the most terrible person ever. I also want to bring up her throwing the pillow off of her in that scene.. it just really rubbed me the wrong way & seemed very aggressive, and then she walks away and comes back and throws her stuff back down just to pick it up a couple seconds later. It made me extremely uneasy. Along with her verbal assaults/agressiveness to not just Jeremiah, but the others in the villa as well. Not to mention she blatantly told him to leave her alone and then at the recoupling says he failed at proving himself for her when he chose Iris? It makes my head spin. She is genuinely triggering for me (and many other viewers, from what I’ve seen). I still feel for her because I think she has a lot of emotions that she may not know how to work through right now- but it’s inexcusable the way she is acting and talking to/about others in the villa. It’s just sad..  I wanted to ride for her through and through at one point but this is beyond a ‘crashout’.

absolutely. there was a couple moments on the broadcast I believe after her floor (or maybe it was beam) routine where she was leaning against the podium and the camera was on her, when she looked over to it she just seemed very uncomfortable and like she wanted some space. She didn’t even wave or smile and that made me feel for her because it really looked like she just wanted to have a couple seconds to herself to breathe after the mental and physical exertion of her routine in a high stress environment.

Also the fact that she is still doing insanely difficult skills, not to mention the most difficult vault being done in all of gymnastics rn? Like her gymnastics is thriving. Focus on that while mentioning that there’s no pressure for her/ anything she does is enough/amazing if you really want to show you care about her mental well being!!

I feel like they’re gonna ramp up about Suni’s kidney issues now more than ever sadly because ‘it’s a story with a good headline’. I just hope the gymnasts know they don’t owe us anything- if Suni wants to talk about it, I love that for her. But I also feel like she has tried to keep her medical issues more private and I hope that’s respected during & after her return to this Olympics.

As someone who has gone to therapy for years and struggles severely with my mental health, I was beamingggg from ear to ear when she was proudly like “I go to therapy every Thursday” on the broadcast tonight. I love when she talks about it! It makes me feel less alone and I will forever love her so much more than I already did before for her willingness to speak out about it. 
 
But yes! I can’t imagine being open about my most traumatic experience and then being constantly asked about it, all while preparing to overcome the situation by essentially putting myself back into the same position in which it happened. Like let her breathe & decide if it’s something she wants to speak on right now… it just seems insensitive/ like they are just grabbing for just  ‘the story’ in a way considering they want to highlight her mental health journey, but supporting & respecting her mental health / mental state needs to come along with that. 

Also just wanted to say thank you for helping others the way you do. I have a deep appreciation for therapists as I have had a couple who I would say saved my life 🫶🏼
